title: Village — Interesting Things the Place Can Offer

entries.value: An unusually large amount of saved coin or valuables
Valuable local specialty product — unusual wool, rare honey
A holy relic or heirloom weapon passed down to the headman
A magical service unique to a local tradition or wise woman
A map or secret leading to a nearby Roman ruin or barrow
A chapel with potent healing prayers or miracle water
A secret treasure buried generations ago
Large amounts of produce or local goods
Ownership of an abandoned farm or cottage
Contacts with rural outlaws or criminal rings
Favours from the lord who is very fond of the village
Young locals willing to take service with the party
